about: (plan U380) Where every piece of the game's art comes from, and its licence. tests/unit/provenance.test.cjs fails if an art file is missing here, or if a shipped file loads an image from outside the repository.

files.origin: Drawn in code for this game: canvas painters (characters, monsters, tiles, buildings, icons, weapons, effects, the map) and their legacy snapshots.
Local page that shows the painters side by side; not loaded by the game.
Script that renders the sheets from the painters (Playwright).
Written by tools/export-sheets.cjs beside the sheets.
The app icon: a sword on navy in the game's interface colours. Added with the mobile port (a49f3dd8, v0.76); the script that drew it isn't in the repository.
